---
title: "Minnesota — 2026 U.S. Senate"
subtitle: "Interactive Precinct-Level Election Results"
page-layout: full
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Hover over any precinct to inspect vote totals for **Peggy Flanagan (DFL)** and **Michele Tafoya (R)**, or use the top-right toggle to switch between **Vote Margin** and **Total Votes Cast**.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapgl)

# Read Minnesota semicolon-delimited precinct results for U.S. Senator
mn_pct <- read_delim("../data/minnesota/MN-data.txt", delim = ";", col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    county_code = as.character(as.integer(X2)),
    pct_code = X3,
    candidate = X8,
    votes = as.numeric(X14)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    flanagan_votes = sum(votes[candidate == "Peggy Flanagan"]),
    tafoya_votes = sum(votes[candidate == "Michele Tafoya"]),
    other_votes = sum(votes[!candidate %in% c("Peggy Flanagan", "Michele Tafoya")]),
    .by = c(county_code, pct_code)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    flanagan_pct = if_else(total_votes > 0, round(100 * flanagan_votes / total_votes, 1), NA_real_),
    tafoya_pct = if_else(total_votes > 0, round(100 * tafoya_votes / total_votes, 1), NA_real_),
    dfl_margin = if_else(total_votes > 0, round(100 * (flanagan_votes - tafoya_votes) / total_votes, 1), NA_real_),
    margin_label = case_when(
      is.na(dfl_margin) ~ "No votes reported",
      dfl_margin > 0 ~ paste0("Flanagan +", dfl_margin, "%"),
      dfl_margin < 0 ~ paste0("Tafoya +", abs(dfl_margin), "%"),
      TRUE ~ "Tied (0.0%)"
    )
  )

# Read, simplify, and reproject Minnesota voting precinct polygons to WGS84
mn_sf <- st_read(
  "../data/minnesota/precincts/bdry_votingdistricts/shp/bdry_votingdistricts.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
) |>
  select(PCTNAME, PCTCODE, COUNTYNAME, COUNTYCODE) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 100, preserveTopology = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  left_join(mn_pct, by = c("COUNTYCODE" = "county_code", "PCTCODE" = "pct_code")) |>
  mutate(
    hover_tip = paste0(
      "<strong>", PCTNAME, "</strong> (", COUNTYNAME, " County)<br>",
      "Margin: <strong>", coalesce(margin_label, "No votes"), "</strong><br>",
      "Peggy Flanagan (DFL): ", coalesce(as.character(flanagan_pct), "0"), "% (", scales::comma(coalesce(flanagan_votes, 0)), ")<br>",
      "Michele Tafoya (R): ", coalesce(as.character(tafoya_pct), "0"), "% (", scales::comma(coalesce(tafoya_votes, 0)), ")<br>",
      "Third-Party / Write-In: ", scales::comma(coalesce(other_votes, 0)), "<br>",
      "Total Precinct Votes: ", scales::comma(coalesce(total_votes, 0))
    )
  )

# Diverging red-white-blue scale for Flanagan vs. Tafoya margin
mn_margin_pal <- interpolate_palette(
  data = mn_sf,
  column = "dfl_margin",
  data_values = c(-60, -30, 0, 30, 60),
  colors = c("#b2182b", "#ef8a62", "#f7f7f7", "#67a9cf", "#2166ac"),
  na_color = "#d9d9d9"
)

# Sequential purple scale for Minnesota precinct vote volume
mn_volume_pal <- interpolate_palette(
  data = mn_sf,
  column = "total_votes",
  data_values = c(100, 350, 900, 1800, 3000),
  colors = c("#edf8fb", "#b3cde3", "#8c96c6", "#8856a7", "#4d004b"),
  na_color = "#d9d9d9"
)

# Build interactive MapLibre precinct map for Minnesota
maplibre(
  style = carto_style("positron"),
  bounds = mn_sf,
  height = "680px"
) |>
  add_source(id = "mn_precincts", data = mn_sf) |>
  add_fill_layer(
    id = "Vote Margin (DFL - R)",
    source = "mn_precincts",
    fill_color = mn_margin_pal$expression,
    fill_opacity = 0.84,
    fill_outline_color = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)",
    tooltip = "hover_tip",
    hover_options = list(fill_opacity = 1, fill_outline_color = "#111111")
  ) |>
  add_fill_layer(
    id = "Total Votes Cast",
    source = "mn_precincts",
    visibility = "none",
    fill_color = mn_volume_pal$expression,
    fill_opacity = 0.84,
    fill_outline_color = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)",
    tooltip = "hover_tip",
    hover_options = list(fill_opacity = 1, fill_outline_color = "#111111")
  ) |>
  add_legend(
    legend_title = "U.S. Senate Margin",
    values = c("Tafoya +60%", "Tafoya +30%", "Even", "Flanagan +30%", "Flanagan +60%"),
    colors = mn_margin_pal$colors,
    type = "continuous",
    position = "bottom-left",
    layer_id = "Vote Margin (DFL - R)",
    add = TRUE
  ) |>
  add_legend(
    legend_title = "Total Precinct Votes",
    values = c("100", "350", "900", "1,800", "3,000+"),
    colors = mn_volume_pal$colors,
    type = "continuous",
    position = "bottom-left",
    layer_id = "Total Votes Cast",
    add = TRUE
  ) |>
  add_layers_control(
    position = "top-right",
    layers = c("Vote Margin (DFL - R)", "Total Votes Cast"),
    collapsible = FALSE,
    mode = "single"
  )
```
